defects.description: Faint 'MOST POPULAR' text in the header has very low contrast against the blue background, making it nearly illegible.
defects.location: Top-left of the card's blue header area

defects.description: The button color is slightly desaturated/muted compared to the vibrant header blue, creating a minor palette inconsistency.
The arrow icon inside the button is very faint and lacks visual weight compared to the bold text.

top_fixes: Increase the contrast of the 'MOST POPULAR' label (use white text or a brighter accent color) to ensure readability.
Saturate the 'Choose Pro' button color to match the vibrancy of the header background for better color cohesion.
Increase the opacity or weight of the arrow icon inside the CTA button to improve its visibility.

manifest.prompt: Create a pricing card for the 'Pro' plan at $12 per month: the plan name, the price, a list of 4 realistic features, and a 'Choose Pro' button.
